Notes

A corpus of only passing cases proves nothing. Without controls like this one, a tool that returned one hundred percent unconditionally would pass the whole suite, and the equivalence fixtures would be measuring nothing at all.

An eight pixel shift is chosen because it is small enough to miss by eye in a side-by-side and large enough that no reasonable threshold should forgive it.
